title: Prove positive common-covector correlation over every finite field (no κ)
body:
This closes Open next question 2 of Nick Petalas's [PR4807](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4807): its common-covector full-guard pair is **strictly positively correlated over every finite field**, in every dimension `m>=2`.

The increment is a modest sign corollary. PR4807 already supplies the exact all-field joint probability, the binary sign and the suggested identity `qD-A^2=q-1`; PR4227 supplies the marginal. The new written proof cancels the credited ratio and derives `J/p^2>L>=1`, preserving strictness at `(q,m)=(2,2)`. Four explicit polynomial identities establish the remaining all-dimension inequalities.

The exact model remains independent columns `a,c`, a common covector `b` with `ba=bc=1`, every proper leading minor of the **corank-one complements** `I-ab,I-cb`, and complete equally weighted `GL_m(F_q)` headers. No new count, arbitrary-pair/larger-family/restricted-header law or physical producer/caller is claimed.

Evidence: two blind-first engines agree on all **205 exact parameter rows and four coefficient arrays**. The primary uses rational closed formulas and interpolation; the oracle uses integer recurrences, Euclidean normalization and polynomial convolution. Four primary strict modes and independent normal/optimized comparisons of the actual submitted profile pass. Non-prime-power rows are algebra fixtures, not finite-field counts. No predecessor checker or GL census was run. All code, immutable inputs and first receipts remain unchanged.

All **26 later external controls** reject for their intended reasons. The original root control harness failed to save its first diagnostic because a slash in the log name became a missing subdirectory; that first subprocess outcome is unknown. Original evidence is retained, only the harness log filename changed, and the corrected full suite is a later run. All four registered commands, committed byte/source-history/mode checks, the final official export/input check and four read-only Git-free empty-PATH cold commands pass. Published/tested tree `5efa6e9e864726c795235bf83dddcd7b3a08d901`. Science frozen at23:42:46.895822UTC; only validation prose/run records changed afterward. Hosted CI succeeded on original run `41741796250`: 711 helper tests (24 skipped), all four registered package commands including both independent comparisons of the actual205-row/four-identity profile, and both staged/unstaged drift checks passed. Synthetic test commit `fa4571380a1d4aa4ac1138806ac595d713ec3811` has the exact verified tree and expected main/PR parents; no actual merge occurred. Mode, source-history and export checks above were local.

Credit Nick Petalas4807/4227/4261/4778/4769/4274, Cinna Davis, source527/commdata2338/Jose Manuel and retained normalizer/recursive-closure lineage. Exact source notices remain intact. Prepared for ToikY with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance and separate AI primary/oracle/static review; Apache-2.0. No human/formal-kernel acceptance, supplier admission, new κ, frontier change or merge requested. Maintainer edits disabled.

Canonical main `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`, all eight guidance bindings, selected6030, exact4807 head/zero feedback, latest open page and liveHub were refreshed unchanged before publication. The changed independent-moment card's paid/target invoice gate remains unmet. Auto-merge is disabled.
